payload.invalid-examples.json of https://trusttasks.org/spec/peer-check/ask/0.1: (1) A challenge below 128 bits (16 bytes) is guessable; the pattern requires at least 22 base64url characters, which encode 132 bits. (2) expiresAt is required in the payload; without an answer deadline the pending question never lapses. (3) question is required; a request with only a challenge asks nothing. (4) question is capped at 200 characters so a prompt stays readable; a long one is refused rather than truncated. (5) Unknown top-level payload member — additionalProperties: false catches `urgency`.
